concepts.name: One MarmotClient per account, built only in browser effects, lease-bound writes
Durable at-least-once, seq-ordered sink idempotent by kind-445 event id
Group handlers take sender only from orderingKey.account
sendGroupRumor canonical rumor id equals sink echo id
Pending store is invitations.pending(); deny layer, caps, single-candidate invite
Join-request protocol on the library inbox, auto-accept at most once
Leave eligibility, admin ops, local purge (abandon)
App/inbox/retired kind registry with import-time collision check
Encrypted media via group.encryptMedia/decryptMedia, Blossom upload
Backup payload has settings and own profile only; NIP-44 to own key
Thin composition root exposing useMarmot() with no protocol logic
{client,pubkey,leaseHeld,enqueue}; leaseHeld reads stores.lease.held
setTimeout(0) FIFO, one job at a time; a job starts after the enqueuing synchronous frame returns (not after the surface settles) — enqueue as last action
kind-10050 ensure port, called once after key-package ensure, non-fatal

gates > openForWrite > createMarmotClient > listeners > inbox handlers 21059/21064 > groups.list > onNotification > inbox.start > KP ensure > 10050 ensure; abortable; fatal step runs contract-order teardown
queue.dispose > unsubscribe > client.dispose > stores.close > pool.destroy; idempotent
INBOX_HANDLER_KINDS defined locally in client; S2 must replace with AppKinds
Dev-only __fewTest.groupLibrary hook installed from MarmotContext.tsx; S18 must keep it; S27 removes it
Own message confirmed on a branch that later loses IS withdrawn through the sink → failed/retry (AC-WDR-2); detection triggers never downgrade confirmed rows
Notification listeners attach per handle (WeakSet), automatically on groupCreated/groupJoined via FIFO; attachGroup idempotent fallback, no-op after teardown
Requested NIP-46 perms = library toNip46Perms() ∪ sign_event:{0,20602,30078,10050}; stored session discarded unless recordedPerms (requested set saved at connect) covers it; null discards
{dispatch, retract}({groupId,eventId,rumor,sender}); sender=orderingKey.account; dispatch idempotent, throws on durable failure; retract of unseen id no-op; only APP_RUMOR_KINDS reach handlers
withdraw of unknown id is a no-op; later append of a withdrawn id is applied (re-canonicalised branch)
seq get-then-set safe only with one backend instance per account under the lease
Before a group first append/withdraw per instance, its dispatched:false rows are re-dispatched in seq order in the same serialised job; abandoned after 5 persisted failures
Injected groupOf(groupId) via client.groups.get for live roster/admin gates; safe inside append (drain starts after runtime cached, group-runtime.js:1196-1217)
Sink single-use per bootstrap, per-account DB few-group-history:<pubkey>; dispose() drains serialiser (≤10 s) and is awaited in teardown before client.dispose; writes are no-ops after dispose
withdraw/purge of an id whose dispatch outlives 10 s retracts once on completion via the per-group serialiser, skipped if the row exists again, ≤3 bounded retries
Sink delivery from self confirms optimistic row by rumor.id (onOwnEcho), never unread/bell; own withdraw → onOwnWithdrawn (failed/retry), never deleted
onGroupNotification drives members/admins/name/disband only, never message stores
Peer senders added to known peers on sink dispatch (subset of roster seeding); never undone by retract
